decisive_items: Demonstrated inferior displacement of the cerebellar tonsils
Inferior displacement of the cerebellar tonsils is a characteristic finding of Chiari Malformation.
response.rationale: Specific imaging finding of cerebellar tonsil displacement is more directly indicative of Chiari Malformation than the CSF collection which could be associated with multiple conditions

rejected.why: Less specific finding of CSF collection
